target_site.name: Camp FreedivePH (Bagalangit / Mainit Point, Mabini, Batangas)

operational_analysis_product.geographic_location: Sheltered Maricaban Strait channel immediately south of Bagalangit Point.

historical_reanalysis_product.geographic_location: Open water of Verde Island Passage / Balayan Bay outer approach (~14 km southwest of site).

cmems_wave.grid_mismatch_note: The 0.2 deg reanalysis cell sits in unsheltered open water 14 km away, causing wave heights to run higher than the sheltered Anilao shore. The 1/12 deg analysis cell sits 3.4 km away directly in the strait.

cmems_currents.geographic_location: Balayan Bay entrance / Northwest passage off Maricaban Island (6.86 km west of site).
cmems_currents.geographic_caveat: In the GLORYS 1/12 deg physics grid, cell (13.6667, 120.9167) is classified as land by Maricaban Island. The nearest open water cell (13.6667, 120.8333) sits on the Balayan Bay approach, capturing open-channel exchange currents rather than the sheltered cove eddy. UI wording must clarify that current speeds reflect this exposed western approach.

era5_atmosphere.gust_methodology: Maximum of 4 surrounding corners to prevent convective squall peak attenuation.

gpm_precipitation.product: NASA GPM IMERG Final Run V07B
gpm_precipitation.source_archive_end_date: 2025-09-30 (Day 273 of 2025, verified via GES DISC OPeNDAP directory listing)
